title: Class Imbalance and Logistic Baseline

learning_objectives: Explain class weighting and threshold selection in plain language and connect it to models.py; tools/lr_clf.py.
Trace one input through the class imbalance and logistic baseline stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the class imbalance and logistic baseline stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for class weighting and threshold selection.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
